description: A big heading, one line and an outline button on the left; on the right three columns of soft white tiles holding pale integration names, drifting slowly up and down at different speeds and fading out at the top and bottom. notes: CSS only; with reduced motion the tiles stand still
names are split into three columns in order; nine or more work best
